lighthouses claimed the lives of many keepers who tended the fires, cleaned the lenses, and wound the clocks in

isolated, harsh conditions.

In the modern era, the advent of GPS and automated electric lighting has rendered most lighthouses obsolete for their
original purpose. Yet, their cultural significance remains undiminished. Today, these historic structures are preserved as museums, hotels, and tourist
attractions, reminding us of a time when human ingenuity battled the elements to keep seafarers safe. They stand not just
